reason: I already treat settlement emails as spam, so a random site that is not a law firm, with listings it admits are unverified, is not something I would sign up for. If I even bother, I would Google the one settlement I heard about and go straight to the official form.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? If you do not file for me and I still have to check the official notice myself, this just feels like another way to grab my email.
would_change_my_mind: If my bank or a store I already use showed me one specific settlement I qualify for and linked me to the official claim form, I might file that one. I still would not create an account to browse a list.
